appliesTo: every API response in scope and the built frontend bundle

checks.name: sensitive fields in API responses
checks.expect: no fields named or containing: password, passwordHash, password_hash, hash, salt, secret, token (except the login response's own token), refreshToken, apiKey, ssn, cardNumber

checks.name: other users' private fields
checks.expect: member lists and lookups return only the documented public fields (e.g. id, name, role; email only where the docs allow)

checks.name: secrets in the frontend bundle
checks.expect: built JS/HTML contain no private keys, JWT secrets, DB connection strings, or API keys other than documented public ones (search for: PRIVATE KEY, secret, DATABASE_URL, postgres://, mysql://, mongodb://, sk_live, AKIA)

checks.name: secrets in client storage
checks.expect: no tokens in localStorage/sessionStorage unless the docs record that decision

checks.name: error responses
checks.expect: no stack traces, SQL, file paths or internal ids of other users

pass: No sensitive field, secret or other user's private data appears anywhere the client can read.
fail: Any listed item found; report the exact response/file and field.
fix: Map DB rows to explicit response DTOs (allow-list fields); keep secrets server-side; strip details from production errors.
